description.value: Sun Bo Kong is a fully vegetarian and vegan Cantonese restaurant that has anchored Vancouver's plant-based dining scene since 1992, built around 100% handmade dim sum and a menu of over 160 authentic dishes. Founded by Ken Chau, the restaurant has long pioneered innovative vegetarian interpretations of classic Chinese cuisine, with some of its original creations now considered mainstream vegetarian staples. Cyclists seeking substantial plant-based fuel will find a calm dine-in room alongside takeout and third-party delivery options.
